strings.zh: 这里是石英高原。{SCROLL}精灵训练家的顶点！{NEWLINE}精灵联盟最高机关,{CLEAR}——精灵联盟总部。
strings.en: Indigo Plateau{SCROLL}The Ultimate Goal for Trainers!{NEWLINE}Pokémon League HQ

strings.zh: 比赛马上就要开始了,{NEWLINE}你做好准备了吗？
strings.en: The match is about to start. Are you{NEWLINE}ready?

strings.zh: 好,我现在就召集选手,{NEWLINE}主持开始比赛。
strings.en: Right, I’ll call the competitors now and{NEWLINE}get the match started.

strings.zh: 各位选手！石英大会正赛{NEWLINE}第二阶段的比赛即将开始。{CLEAR}你们的英姿将通过电视转播{CLEAR}展示给全地区的观众。{SCROLL}期待你们拿出{NEWLINE}石英大会8强的水平和斗志,{CLEAR}为观众们奉献上精彩的比赛。{SCROLL}我现在宣布{NEWLINE}石英大会第二阶段淘汰赛,{CLEAR}正式开始！！！
strings.en: Attention, all competitors!{SCROLL}Stage two of the Indigo Conference main{NEWLINE}tournament is about to begin.{SCROLL}Your finest moments will be broadcast{NEWLINE}on TV to viewers across the region.{SCROLL}We look forward to you showing the skill{NEWLINE}and fighting spirit of the Indigo{CLEAR}Conference’s top eight, and giving the{CLEAR}audience some thrilling matches.{SCROLL}I now declare the Indigo Conference{NEWLINE}stage-two knockout rounds officially{CLEAR}under way!!!
strings.notes: Tournament branch (pre-Rocket Indigo Conference): #1–3, #132–133, #175–205.

v3 TM: 138 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl) | zh 空 (empty placeholder).

strings.zh: 联盟总部重地,必须严加戒备。
strings.en: League HQ is a vital site. Security must{NEWLINE}be tight.

strings.zh: 冠军大人您好,{NEWLINE}欢迎来到精灵联盟总部。
strings.en: Hello, Champion. Welcome to{NEWLINE}Pokémon League HQ.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『一树、梨花,{NEWLINE}终于让我找到你们了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Will, Karen! I’ve finally found{NEWLINE}you!
strings.notes: Rocket-occupation branch (endgame): #6–88 (Will and Karen hold the plaza; Steven and Cynthia help).

strings.zh: 一树『没想到冠军大人{NEWLINE}对我们感情这么深。
strings.en: Will: I never knew the Champion was so{NEWLINE}attached to us.

strings.zh: 梨花『你费尽千辛万苦登上石英高原,{NEWLINE}就是为了见我们一面吗？
strings.en: Karen: You climbed all the way up the{NEWLINE}Indigo Plateau just to see us?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『少跟我耍嘴皮子,{NEWLINE}四天王现在还被关在梦境世界,{CLEAR}要怎么才能把他们救出来！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Cut the smart talk.{SCROLL}The Elite Four are still trapped in the{NEWLINE}Dream World. How do I get them out?!

strings.zh: 一树『既然你诚心诚意地发问了。
strings.en: Will: Prepare for trouble!
strings.notes: Motto parody, canon dub opener (D-1437).

strings.zh: 梨花『那我们就大发慈悲地告诉你。
strings.en: Karen: And make it double!

strings.zh: 一树『只要你能从我们这里{NEWLINE}解放克雷色利亚和达克莱伊,{CLEAR}它们就会回到梦境世界。
strings.en: Will: If you can free Cresselia and{NEWLINE}Darkrai from us, they’ll return to the{CLEAR}Dream World.

strings.zh: 梨花『在它们回梦境世界的时候,{NEWLINE}会打开一条连接现实世界{CLEAR}和梦境世界的通道,{CLEAR}那时候四天王就可以{CLEAR}从梦境世界出来了。
strings.en: Karen: When they go back, they’ll open{NEWLINE}a passage between the real world and{CLEAR}the Dream World.{SCROLL}Then the Elite Four can come out of the{NEWLINE}Dream World.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这么轻易就把方法告诉我,{NEWLINE}看来你们对自己的实力非常自信啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’re telling me how that{NEWLINE}easily?{SCROLL}You must be very sure of your own{NEWLINE}strength.

strings.zh: 一树『这可不是凭空而来的自信。{NEWLINE}克雷色利亚的力量{CLEAR}你已经见识过很多次了,{CLEAR}我要用它一雪被你打败的耻辱。
strings.en: Will: This confidence didn’t come from{NEWLINE}nowhere.{SCROLL}You’ve seen Cresselia’s power plenty of{NEWLINE}times already.{SCROLL}I’ll use it to wipe away the shame of{NEWLINE}losing to you.

strings.zh: 梨花『跟我们对战{NEWLINE}会是你这辈子最可怕的噩梦。
strings.en: Karen: Battling us will be the worst{NEWLINE}nightmare of your life.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好啊,我倒要看看你们两个{NEWLINE}只会靠传说中精灵的懦夫{CLEAR}能长进到什么程度。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Fine.{SCROLL}Let’s see how far you two cowards, who{NEWLINE}can only lean on Legendary Pokémon,{CLEAR}have come.

strings.zh: 一树『着什么急啊,{NEWLINE}先让我的部下们陪你热热身。
strings.en: Will: What’s the rush? First, let my{NEWLINE}subordinates warm you up.

strings.zh: 梨花『你们几个,把咱们火箭队{NEWLINE}强化精灵的成果{CLEAR}给冠军大人展示展示。
strings.en: Karen: You lot, show the Champion what{NEWLINE}our Pokémon enhancement can do!
Yes, ma’am!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.en: The League Champion really is strong.
I can’t battle anymore.
Our turn!
We’ll wear you down, no matter what!
Forgive me, I failed...
I’m at my limit...

strings.zh: 一树『很好,能把他消耗到这个程度,{NEWLINE}我们已经胜券在握了。
strings.en: Will: Excellent. With him worn down this{NEWLINE}far, victory is ours.

strings.zh: 一树『很好,能把她消耗到这个程度,{NEWLINE}我们已经胜券在握了。
strings.en: Will: Excellent. With her worn down this{NEWLINE}far, victory is ours.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『又是这种卑鄙的车轮战,{NEWLINE}真不愧是火箭队。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Another dirty gauntlet, one{NEWLINE}fresh opponent after another.{SCROLL}Typical Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 梨花『能不能赢才是最重要的。{NEWLINE}毕竟死人没法指责别人卑鄙,哈哈。
strings.en: Karen: Winning is all that matters.{SCROLL}After all, dead people can’t call anyone{NEWLINE}dirty. Ha ha.

strings.zh: 大吾『趁人之危也要有个限度。
strings.en: Steven: There are limits to kicking{NEWLINE}someone when they’re down.

strings.zh: 希罗娜『用这种不公平的方式对战,{NEWLINE}你们还算是训练家吗？
strings.en: Cynthia: Battling in such an unfair{NEWLINE}way...{SCROLL}Can you even call yourselves Trainers?

strings.zh: 一树『这不是当年{NEWLINE}石英大会上的两个废物么,{CLEAR}成为地区冠军之后好神气啊。
strings.en: Will: Well, well. The two useless losers{NEWLINE}from the Indigo Conference back then.{SCROLL}Becoming regional Champions sure has{NEWLINE}gone to your heads.
strings.notes: tone review: 废物 = 'useless losers' (D-0627)

strings.zh: 梨花『冥王大人刚刚已经{NEWLINE}把你们的战斗数据告诉我们了。{CLEAR}并为你们各准备了一只特殊的队伍。
strings.en: Karen: Master Charon just gave us your{NEWLINE}battle data.{SCROLL}And he’s prepared a special team for{NEWLINE}each of you.

strings.zh: 梨花『喂,你们两个过来吧！
strings.en: Karen: Hey, you two, get over here!
Come on out, Magmortar.
Magmortar: Maaaaa-mo!
You’re up, Altaria.
Altaria: Aaaaa-ta!
Regional Champions, huh?

strings.zh: 让你们看看火箭队的厉害！
strings.en: We’ll show you what Team Rocket can do!

strings.zh: 大吾『有两下子嘛,但还差得远呢。{NEWLINE}巨金怪！
strings.en: Steven: Not bad, but you’ve still got a{NEWLINE}long way to go. Metagross!
Metagross: Meeeee-ta!

strings.zh: 希罗娜『妖精系的七夕青鸟确实少见,{NEWLINE}但我的烈咬陆鲨也不是没有办法应对！{CLEAR}上啊,烈咬陆鲨！
strings.en: Cynthia: A Fairy-type Altaria is{NEWLINE}certainly rare, but my Garchomp isn’t{CLEAR}without answers!{SCROLL}Go, Garchomp!
Garchomp: Gaaaa-cho!

strings.zh: 一树大人,这帮家伙好强啊。
strings.en: Master Will, these guys are too strong.

strings.zh: 即使用克制他们的精灵也……
strings.en: Even with Pokémon that have the type{NEWLINE}advantage...
Will: Don’t panic. I’m here.

strings.zh: 梨花『利用二对一的优势速战速决。{NEWLINE}然后再腾出手来对付最难缠的家伙。
strings.en: Karen: Use our two-on-one advantage{NEWLINE}and finish this fast.{SCROLL}Then we’ll be free to deal with the{NEWLINE}toughest one.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『又想以多欺少？{NEWLINE}大吾我来帮你！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ganging up again? Steven, I’ll{NEWLINE}help you!

strings.zh: 达克莱伊『Daaa……{SCROLL}达克莱伊变得虚弱了。
strings.en: Darkrai: Daaa...{SCROLL}Darkrai grew weak.

strings.zh: 梨花『不！达克莱伊！{NEWLINE}你的力量已经用尽了吗？
strings.en: Karen: No! Darkrai! Is your power all{NEWLINE}used up?

strings.zh: 大吾『真是久违的并肩作战啊,{VAR:0103:0}。{NEWLINE}没有比你更值得信赖的队友了。
strings.en: Steven: It’s been a long time since we{NEWLINE}fought side by side, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}There’s no teammate I trust more than{NEWLINE}you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『客气了。{NEWLINE}希罗娜那边还没结束,{CLEAR}我先过去帮她。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You flatter me. Cynthia’s{NEWLINE}fight isn’t over yet. I’ll go help her.

strings.zh: 一树『克雷色利亚！你的美梦之力呢？{NEWLINE}快用力量给自己回复啊！
strings.en: Will: Cresselia! Where’s the power of{NEWLINE}your sweet dreams?{SCROLL}Use it to heal yourself, now!

strings.zh: 克雷色利亚『Creee……{SCROLL}克雷色利亚没有力气了。
strings.en: Cresselia: Creee...{SCROLL}Cresselia has no strength left.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『希罗娜、大吾,{NEWLINE}破坏一树和梨花手中的精灵球,{CLEAR}解放克雷色利亚和达克莱伊！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Cynthia, Steven!{SCROLL}Smash the Poké Balls Will and Karen are{NEWLINE}holding, and free Cresselia and Darkrai!

strings.zh: 希罗娜『没问题！{NEWLINE}大吾『交给我们吧！
strings.en: Cynthia: You got it!{NEWLINE}Steven: Leave it to us!

strings.zh: 希罗娜『烈咬陆鲨！{NEWLINE}大吾『巨金怪！{SCROLL}希罗娜『破坏一树手里的精灵球！{NEWLINE}大吾『破坏梨花手里的精灵球！
strings.en: Cynthia: Garchomp!{NEWLINE}Steven: Metagross!{SCROLL}Cynthia: Smash Will’s Poké Ball!{NEWLINE}Steven: Smash Karen’s Poké Ball!
Will: Hey! You bastards!

strings.zh: 梨花『这是我们好不容易{NEWLINE}才得到的传说中精灵！！
strings.en: Karen: We went through hell to get{NEWLINE}those Legendary Pokémon!!
Cresselia: Creee-se!
Darkrai: Daaaa-kra!

strings.zh: 一树『完了……克雷色利亚逃走了……
strings.en: Will: It’s over... Cresselia got away...
Karen: I’m sorry, Boss Giovanni...
{VAR:0103:0}: Steven, Cynthia.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这里的火箭队全都被击败了,{NEWLINE}现在麻烦你们看住这些家伙,{CLEAR}不要放跑任何一个。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All of Team Rocket here has{NEWLINE}been beaten.{SCROLL}Could you two keep watch over them?{NEWLINE}Don’t let a single one escape.

strings.zh: 希罗娜『没问题,听你的安排。
strings.en: Cynthia: No problem. Whatever you say.
Steven: Leave it to us!

strings.zh: 冠军大人你能来真是太好了！
strings.en: Champion, I’m so glad you’re here!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你是……{NEWLINE}精灵联盟科技部的部长先生？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’re... the head of the{NEWLINE}League’s Technology Department?

strings.zh: 是的,冠军大人。{NEWLINE}火箭队逼迫我修改了{CLEAR}总部广场的飞空术屏蔽命令,{CLEAR}让联盟的训练家{CLEAR}无法使用飞空术降落在这里。{CLEAR}我看您刚刚已经打败了火箭队,{CLEAR}所以我又把屏蔽命令给解除了,{CLEAR}现在您可以使用飞空术{CLEAR}自由地出入总部广场。
strings.en: Yes, Champion.{SCROLL}Team Rocket forced me to change the{NEWLINE}Fly-blocking command on the HQ plaza,{CLEAR}so League Trainers couldn’t use Fly to{CLEAR}land here.{SCROLL}I saw that you just defeated Team{NEWLINE}Rocket, so I lifted the block again.{SCROLL}You can now use Fly to come and go from{NEWLINE}the HQ plaza freely.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『谢谢你,这样一来就方便多了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thank you. That makes things{NEWLINE}a lot easier.

strings.zh: 包括达马兰奇主席和两位部长在内的{NEWLINE}众多精灵联盟官员,{CLEAR}被火箭队关在了四天王房间里,{CLEAR}由火箭队的干部们分别看管。{CLEAR}请您一定要把他们救出来啊,拜托了！
strings.en: Team Rocket has locked many{NEWLINE}Pokémon League officials, including{CLEAR}President Goodshow and two department{CLEAR}heads, in the Elite Four’s rooms, each{CLEAR}guarded by Team Rocket’s Executives.{SCROLL}Please, you have to rescue them. I’m{NEWLINE}begging you!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好的,我这就去救他们。{NEWLINE}你放心吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: OK, I’ll go rescue them right{NEWLINE}now. Don’t worry!
Go get ’em, Champion!

strings.zh: 大吾『看押火箭队的事交给我们,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}你快去总部大楼解救人质吧。
strings.en: Steven: Leave guarding Team Rocket to{NEWLINE}us.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, hurry to the HQ building and{NEWLINE}rescue the hostages.

strings.zh: 希罗娜『看押火箭队的事交给我们,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}你快去总部大楼解救人质吧。
strings.en: Cynthia: Leave guarding Team Rocket to{NEWLINE}us.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, hurry to the HQ building and{NEWLINE}rescue the hostages.
Boo-hoo-hoo, I don’t want to go to{NEWLINE}prison...
What a rotten feeling...

strings.zh: 我有不好的预感,{NEWLINE}火箭队这次真的要完蛋了。
strings.en: I’ve got a bad feeling Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}really finished this time.

strings.zh: 被抓了……老大能来救我们吗？
strings.en: We got caught... Will the Boss come save{NEWLINE}us?

strings.zh: 冠军大人,我是女的。{NEWLINE}你说如果以后给我们判刑,{CLEAR}会因为我的性别对我从轻发落吗？
strings.en: Champion, I’m a woman.{SCROLL}If they sentence us someday, will I get{NEWLINE}off lighter because I’m a woman?

strings.zh: 看什么看,{NEWLINE}你肯定不是坂木大人的对手。
strings.en: What’re you looking at? You’re{NEWLINE}definitely no match for Master Giovanni.

strings.zh: 一树『火箭队干部们{NEWLINE}使用的传说中精灵,{CLEAR}全都不亚于克雷色利亚,{CLEAR}你就去四天王的房间里{CLEAR}好好感受一下什么叫做地狱吧。
strings.en: Will: The Legendary Pokémon the Team{NEWLINE}Rocket Executives use are every bit as{CLEAR}strong as Cresselia.{SCROLL}Go on into the Elite Four’s rooms and{NEWLINE}get a real taste of hell.

strings.zh: 梨花『既然被你们抓了,{NEWLINE}我也没什么好说的。{CLEAR}想怎么处置悉听尊便！
strings.en: Karen: You’ve caught me, so I’ve got{NEWLINE}nothing to say.{SCROLL}Do whatever you want with me!

strings.zh: 前面是精灵联盟总部大楼,{NEWLINE}您现在要去的不是这里吧？
strings.en: Up ahead is the Pokémon League HQ{NEWLINE}building.{SCROLL}That’s not where you need to go right{NEWLINE}now, is it?

strings.zh: 你们的英姿将通过摄像机{NEWLINE}展示给整个地区哦！
strings.en: Your finest moments will be shown to the{NEWLINE}whole region through my camera!

strings.zh: 需要我帮您回复精灵吗？
strings.en: Shall I heal your Pokémon for you?
Your Pokémon are fully healed.
Blastoise: Blas-toi!
Venusaur: Venu-sau!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s)

strings.zh: 小绿『即便对手是认识的朋友,{NEWLINE}我也一定会赢的。
strings.en: Blue: Even if my opponent’s a friend,{NEWLINE}I’m going to win.

strings.zh: 小蓝『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}我这次的对手很不好对付,{CLEAR}不知道我还能不能赢……
strings.en: Green: {VAR:0103:0}, my opponent this time{NEWLINE}is really tough.{SCROLL}I don’t know if I can win...
strings.notes: Partner branch: Green lines (#182/#185/#187) for a male player, Red lines (#183/#186/#188) for a female player.

strings.zh: 小赤『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}我这次的对手很不好对付,{CLEAR}但我会尽力的。
strings.en: Red: {VAR:0103:0}, my opponent this time is{NEWLINE}really tough, but I’ll do my best.

strings.zh: 小绿『过会儿你就看我{NEWLINE}暴揍那个狂妄的小丑吧。
strings.en: Blue: In a bit, you can watch me pound{NEWLINE}that arrogant clown.

strings.zh: 小蓝『谢谢你{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}能跟你们成为朋友真是太好了。
strings.en: Green: Thank you, {VAR:0103:0}. I’m so glad{NEWLINE}I became friends with you guys.

strings.zh: 小赤『谢谢你{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}能跟你们成为朋友真是太好了。
strings.en: Red: Thank you, {VAR:0103:0}. I’m so glad I{NEWLINE}became friends with you guys.

strings.zh: 小蓝『看到{VAR:0103:0}你和小绿{NEWLINE}都要在决赛加油啊,{CLEAR}可不能给咱们真新镇的训练家丢脸！
strings.en: Green: {VAR:0103:0}, you and Blue had both{NEWLINE}better give it your all in the finals!{SCROLL}Don’t embarrass us Trainers from Pallet{NEWLINE}Town!

strings.zh: 小赤『看到{VAR:0103:0}你和小绿{NEWLINE}都要在决赛加油啊,{CLEAR}好不负咱们真新镇训练家之名！
strings.en: Red: {VAR:0103:0}, you and Blue had both{NEWLINE}better give it your all in the finals!{SCROLL}Do us Pallet Town Trainers proud!
strings.notes: RV025: omission: 真新镇训练家之名: ‘Trainers’ restored

strings.zh: 梨花『嘿,这个分组简直就是{NEWLINE}为了让我们进入决赛准备的。
strings.en: Karen: Heh, this bracket might as well{NEWLINE}have been made to put us in the finals.

strings.zh: 梨花『你们这些井底之蛙,{NEWLINE}现在知道我们的厉害了吧？
strings.en: Karen: You frogs in a well. Now you know{NEWLINE}what we can do, huh?

strings.zh: 梨花『不要以为{NEWLINE}我们会就此善罢甘休。
strings.en: Karen: Don’t think we’ll let this go.

strings.zh: 一树『会玩超能力的可不止娜姿,{NEWLINE}我要让你们瞧瞧我的厉害。
strings.en: Will: Sabrina’s not the only one who can{NEWLINE}play with psychic powers.{SCROLL}I’ll show you what I can do.

strings.zh: 一树『哈哈哈哈哈,{NEWLINE}想击败我们是不可能的！
strings.en: Will: Hah hah hah hah hah! There’s no{NEWLINE}way you can beat us!
Will: Just you wait!

strings.zh: 希罗娜『小绿最厉害的精灵{NEWLINE}是水箭龟,{CLEAR}我的烈咬陆鲨应该可以跟它对抗。
strings.en: Cynthia: Blue’s strongest Pokémon is{NEWLINE}Blastoise.{SCROLL}My Garchomp should be able to stand up{NEWLINE}to it.

strings.zh: 希罗娜『能打到这里{NEWLINE}我已经心满意足了。{CLEAR}剩下的就看你们的咯！
strings.en: Cynthia: I’m happy just making it this{NEWLINE}far. The rest is up to you!

strings.zh: 希罗娜『以冠军为目标加油吧！
strings.en: Cynthia: Aim for the Championship! Good{NEWLINE}luck!

strings.zh: 大吾『如果可以的话,{NEWLINE}我还是更想跟戴面罩的那位交手。{CLEAR}跟你对战总感觉有些信心不足。
strings.en: Steven: If I could choose, I’d rather{NEWLINE}face the one in the mask.{SCROLL}Battling you always leaves me a little{NEWLINE}short on confidence.

strings.zh: 大吾『{VAR:0103:0}你还是一如既往的强。{NEWLINE}保持这个势头{CLEAR}继续努力获胜下去吧！
strings.en: Steven: {VAR:0103:0}, you’re as strong as{NEWLINE}ever.{SCROLL}Keep up this momentum and keep on{NEWLINE}winning!

strings.zh: 大吾『四天王都是很厉害的对手,{NEWLINE}加油呀！
strings.en: Steven: The Elite Four are all very{NEWLINE}tough opponents. Good luck!
Garchomp: Garc-chom!
Metagross: Meta-gros!

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0}你要好好打啊,{NEWLINE}期待半决赛跟你会师哦。
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, give it your best, you{NEWLINE}hear?{SCROLL}I’m looking forward to meeting you in{NEWLINE}the semifinals.

strings.zh: 小霞『我输了没有关系,{NEWLINE}可是看到那种家伙赢了,{CLEAR}就觉得好气！{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0},你半决赛时{CLEAR}要替我和小蓝狠狠教训他们啊！
strings.en: Misty: I don’t mind losing, but seeing{NEWLINE}people like that win makes me so mad!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, in the semifinals, teach them a{NEWLINE}hard lesson for me and Green!

strings.zh: 小霞『训练家的顶点近在眼前了,{NEWLINE}你一定可以的！
strings.en: Misty: The top of the Trainer world is{NEWLINE}right in front of you. You can do it!
Starmie: Sta-mi!
